entries.english: Introduce the public CLI and Go SDK, with multi-account local authentication, search, detail, magnets, tags, browsing, entity filmographies, user lists, rankings, TOP250, and collections.
entries.zh_cn: 新增公开 CLI 与 Go SDK，覆盖多账号本地认证、搜索、详情、磁力、标签、浏览、实体片单、用户列表、排行、TOP250 与合集。

entries.english: Add machine-readable version output, bilingual documentation, a quality CI gate, multi-architecture release packaging, and Homebrew formula support.
entries.zh_cn: 新增机器可读的版本输出、双语文档、质量 CI 门禁、多架构发布打包与 Homebrew Formula 支持。
